verdict_text: NO. The sharding function does not force `gpt_neox.embed_in.weight` and `embed_out.weight` into individual shards; because each is only about 206 MB—below 512 MiB—it may pack other tensors alongside them. This violates the explicit sharding clause requiring each of those tensors to be stored alone.
